jobs.description:
The centralized QA team (25 members) ensures software quality across multiple tax compliance, seller growth, tax invoicing, and AI-powered systems supporting multiple leaders. The potential candidate will help with moving QA from traditional manual testing to an AI-native, automation-first Quality Engineering team. QA should speed up delivery and influence launches, not just sign off on them.Exciting opportunity to work on Amazon LLMs , AI and Agentic products.

Key job responsibilities
Test Driven development
Building, maintaining test Automation framework and increasing test coverage, converting QA tasks into AI Native ways
Test Planning and strategy for AI , agentic applications
Test data creation
Test Execution
Defect creation, root cause analysis and triage
Production Monitoring
Stakeholder communication on project status, blockers, risks and mitigations
Handling multiple projects
Hands on using AI tools and master with Playwright for test automation

About the team
The International Seller Growth (ISG) Quality Assurance (QA) team owns quality assurance for products supporting Amazon's global seller compliance ecosystem covering 30+ countries, 350K+ sellers, and $95B in Gross Merchandise Sales (GMS).

jobs.description: The successful candidate will ensure that accounting processes are run in a controlled environment, meeting and exceeding our customers’ expectations. This role requires working with central accounting, finance operation and Global financial teams to ensure we have a controlled accounting process to do month end accounting and reporting activities in a manner fitting with our "Customer Obsession", “Deliver Results” and “Insist on Highest Standard” philosophy.  The Financial Analyst II is responsible for smooth operations of global accounting team at Bangalore, which includes closing the global books of accounts, posting of journal entries, preparing global general ledger account reconciliations, reporting and having reviews with leadership team. The person needs to ensure that the finance processes are operating at the optimum capacity, and partnering with operations and accounting team to achieve the annual operating plan. The Accounting team is responsible for preparing, reviewing and reporting on general ledger account and operational reconciliations. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining key financial and operational metrics, analyzing and reporting monthly variance analysis and providing ad-hoc reporting and analysis. This individual will also establish and embed principals of financial controls by measuring the quality of general ledger account reconciliations, creating dashboards and metrics to measure quality of processes and controls.
